conclusion: Step6 improved relative to step2 but remains worse than the fixed original candidate-order baseline; this model has not demonstrated a ranking improvement over that baseline.

fixed_original_candidate_order_baseline.definition: Original stored candidate order, without any model- or target-based reordering.

limitations: This development set was already known and teacher-seen; this is not a blind evaluation.
All 148 target-absent pools remain in the denominator with zero credit.
33 pools worsened in reciprocal rank despite a small aggregate improvement.
No final acceptance-set data was used.
Linux CPU research results do not constitute Windows IME product acceptance.
The original-order baseline is an offline comparison, not a native Windows replay.
Teacher target accuracy on the identical development-set scope has not yet been established; six student updates do not establish convergence.
